author: Praxis I
title: BRBG-Dual-AdaptPC: Equal-Quota Graph k=42 (adaptive residualization)
abstract: Adaptive per-PC residualization (γ_j=min(0.74, 0.9·R²_j)) with ComBat-PCA64 embedding and equal-quotas balanced kNN at k=42. Completes the small-degree sweep (42/45/48) to check for marginal gains over k=48 (EID 185=0.7209).
